instruction:
Work from /home/user/Desktop/arm_single.step in BRL-CAD. Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). On this machine, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `arm_single.step`.

Copy the single arm around Z into three arms spaced by 120 degrees, with the inner ends coincident, and fuse them into a three-spoke hub. Cut a central through hole of diameter 12 mm. The final geometry must be the single fused hub. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl.
